exempt.AnyView: Type erasure: it wraps another view and has nothing to configure.
exempt.EquatableView: A wrapper that only skips re-rendering; the equatable() modifier builds it.
exempt.TupleView: Builder plumbing: the result of a ViewBuilder block.
exempt.Content: The placeholder name of a generic container's content, not a component.
exempt.PlaceholderContentView: The placeholder a ViewModifier receives, not a component.
exempt._ListSelectionRow: A row List draws for its selection; it is not used directly.
exempt._SelectableListRow: A row List draws for its selection; it is not used directly.
exempt.OutlineSubgroupChildren: The children OutlineGroup passes to its content, not a component.
exempt.ChartPlotContent: The plot a Chart hands to chartPlotStyle, not a component.
exempt.WebMountSurface: The surface the framework mounts a DOMViewRepresentable into.
exempt.Description: A part of ContentUnavailableView.search, named as in SwiftUI's SearchUnavailableContent; not used directly.
exempt.Actions: A part of ContentUnavailableView.search, named as in SwiftUI's SearchUnavailableContent; not used directly.
exempt.NavigationView: Deprecated in SwiftUI, replaced by NavigationStack and NavigationSplitView.

pending.AsyncImage: Needs a remote image; an entry with a local data URL is next.
pending.Canvas: Needs a drawing closure the knobs can drive.
pending.Chart: Lives in SwiftUIWebCharts; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.Map: Lives in SwiftUIWebMapKit; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.VideoPlayer: Lives in SwiftUIWebAVKit; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.MotionView: Lives in SwiftUIWebMotion; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.WebContentView: Lives in SwiftUIWebWeb; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.PhotosPicker: Lives in SwiftUIWebPhotosUI; the site does not depend on the optional modules yet.
pending.EditButton: Needs a List in edit mode beside it.
pending.GlassEffectContainer: A newer SwiftUI container; an entry with the glass modifiers is next.
pending.LazyHGrid: LazyVGrid is shown; the horizontal grid is next.
pending.NavigationLink: Navigation inside a page conflicts with the site's own tabs and history; a dedicated entry is next.
pending.NavigationSplitView: Navigation inside a page conflicts with the site's own tabs and history; a dedicated entry is next.
pending.NavigationStack: Navigation inside a page conflicts with the site's own tabs and history; a dedicated entry is next.
pending.TabView: A TabView inside the site's own TabView; a dedicated entry is next.
pending.ToolbarItem: Needs a navigation container to show a toolbar.
pending.ToolbarItemGroup: Needs a navigation container to show a toolbar.
